messages:
Ava (Marketing): ok team — finalizing greenroom + stage tech checklist for next Tuesday's webinar. want a quick sweep on speaker order, demo fallbacks, and AV handoffs. thinking 40m talk + 15m q&a. can everyone confirm availability? :white_check_mark:
Sam (Events Ops): yep available. i'll run the dry run on Mon 10am PT. can we lock slide deck uploads by EOD Mon? :calendar:
Riley (Prod Marketing): sending speaker slate now — 1) Priya (LLM infra) 2) Marco (Cost & perf) 3) Lila (customer case). will share abstracts + 3-slide demo cue cards. link: https://drive.redwood/example-decks
Diego (Eng): for the demo fallback — recommend we prerecord the demo clip and have a containerized fallback that returns cached outputs. if live model spikes, we switch to prerecorded.
Diego (Eng): sample switch command for infra if we need to toggle to fallback during live:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/switch -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"route":"webinar-model","variant":"prerecord-2026-03-23"}'
```
Nico (Video): greenroom camera check plan: two cameras (presenter + slides), NDI feed to OBS, we need presenters to join 15m early. internet min 10mbps upload. i can send a checklist for presenters.
Ava (Marketing): perfect. Sam, add prerecorded file and routing to run-of-show. Riley, can you pin the 3-slide cue cards to the deck so Nico can preview?
Sam (Events Ops): added to run-of-show draft:
- 00:00 join + housekeeping (Ava)
- 02:00 opening (Priya)
- 18:00 demo (Marco) — live then fallback clip at 20:00 if errors
- 30:00 customer case (Lila)
- 38:00 live q&a (panel)
- 53:00 wrap
Sam (Events Ops): also note: countdown timer and mic checks 5m before go. verified with platform team on token rotations.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run-invite -> Mon 10:00 PT to @Sam @Priya @Marco @Lila @Nico @Ava
Riley (Prod Marketing): speakers please upload final slides to the folder by Mon 5pm PT. i'll do a content pass after upload.
Diego (Eng): quick note on demo KPIs -> aim for <250ms median latency during replay and have an autoscale policy to add 1 GPU on error threshold 10% failed requests over 30s.
Ava (Marketing): good call. let's add a monitoring card to the producer dashboard and a one-line fallback script that Sam can run. Sam, can you own post-webinar clip (30s highlights) ops?
Sam (Events Ops): yes — i'll produce highlights and seed to social. also capturing attendee questions for follow-up.
Nico (Video): will run a 10m camera/lights check during dry-run. presenters: please test background blur and headphones.
Riley (Prod Marketing): i've drafted the attendee email and 1-line press hook, will drop in the doc for review.
Ava (Marketing): awesome. last ask: can we do a quick 15m mic + demo/network run 30m before start on Wed just in case? who can stay for that?
Diego (Eng): i can. will be on standby for the switch command.
Nico (Video): i'll stay.
Sam (Events Ops): i'll coordinate and post the final run-of-show 24h before. :rocket:
Ava (Marketing): thanks everyone — feeling good. i'll post the final checklist here after Mon dry-run. :party_parrot:
